messages:
olivia (PM): Need a compact tenant-stability gating playbook for multi-region pilots. Goal: make the pilot bounded and contract-ready. Quick reactions?

hassan (Eng): propose minimal flow: sandbox smoke -> 1-tenant internal pilot -> 3% prod for 6h -> 30% 12h -> full. Each step timeboxed + automated rollback.

lee (Arch): add policy-level guard: if tenant p99 > 2x baseline for >5m OR KV miss rate > 15%, block progression and trigger affinity lane migration. Define migration cooldown (15m) to prevent thrash.

 taylor (SRE): ops pre-reqs before any prod pilot:
- alerts: tenant.p99.spike, region.failover.init, cache.warmup.miss
- smoke harness to run top-25 prompts every 10m during canary
- chaos micro-test in staging (egress drop) with one internal tenant
Fail any -> immediate rollback.

maria (Sales): customer (Acme-esque) wants 30s RTO + tail latency SLA. Recommend we standardize contract language: "automated routing switch within 60s; expected full performance restoration within 10 minutes under normal load".

hassan (Eng): technical note: routing switch can happen <60s, cache-dependent perf restoration varies by model size. Include model-variant fallback (quantized) in playbook.

olivia (PM): draft launch thresholds for pilot (pass/fail):
- per-tenant p99 <= 180ms for regional traffic
- combined error rate < 0.7%
- routing switch init < 60s
- cache hit ratio >= 85% within 10m for pinned tenants
- no top-10 prompt regressions (embedding-similarity)
We'll tune after internal pilot.

lee (Arch): acceptance checklist add-on: automated regression harness comparing embedding similarity to baseline + manual QA signoff before moving past 30% stage.

taylor (SRE): add runbook steps and explicit rollback commands to the PR. Also require alert dashboards linked in the runbook.

olivia (PM): action items: @hassan - routing-policy PR with canary hooks; @taylor - runbook + chaos plan; @lee - acceptance checklist + policy doc; @maria - confirm contract wording with customer. I'll assemble the gating matrix doc and share.

cutover-bot: Created ticket ARCH-PT-4201: tenant-stability-gating. Owners: hassan, taylor, lee, olivia. ETA: 2025-07-25.

maria (Sales): noted, will push for pilot window and legal language. :thumbsup:

olivia (PM): thanks everyone, publishing draft tonight for quick review.
